summary: Every judge the audio QC and speech-analysis harness runs or has run, as it is today: pins, weight and training-data licenses, license tier, independence, identity split and status. Describes; qualifies nothing. Calibration stays legacy-unqualified until a qualification record exists (AQ-03, AQ-07).

1.summary: Correct the registry and retire NISQA, UTMOSv2 and the SER from every QC path; the relative-UTMOS guardrail is dropped until the section 4.6 composite passes its ladder test.

2.summary: Tier B is accepted for internal evaluation that never ships, recorded per judge.

3.summary: Judges from the generator's lab never vote: an adjudicator only corroborates, an aligner only supplies intervals, and neither provides labels.

4.summary: Downloads are staged: the panel judges the current languages need first, then the rest; the maintainer runs every download (scripts/acquire_audio_qc_judges.py).

7.summary: Adoption requires two clean canonical-host runs; the 8 GB Mac and iPhone floors are product constraints, not evaluator constraints.

9.summary: A budgeted admission semaphore after the generator exits replaces the host-wide single-analyzer flock for the orchestrator's workers; the child-attributed post-exit recovery rule becomes binding once M6 evidence supports it and stays report-only until then.

tiers.A: Permissive weights, and training data whose terms allow commercial use, or no learned weights at all.
tiers.B: Permissive weights, but training data includes scraped web audio or corpora whose rights stay with the original owners, with no explicit non-commercial term. Internal, never-shipped evaluation only (decision 2a).
tiers.C: Non-commercial weights, or training data under an explicit non-commercial or research-only term. Never runs in a QC path.

statuses.candidate: Registered with pins, a tier and independence fields; research use only.
statuses.shadow: Runs beside the current judges; its verdicts are uncalibrated and never block.
statuses.warn: Feeds a detector qualified at its warn operating point.
statuses.gating: Feeds a verdict that can fail a take or a lane.
statuses.retired: Removed from every QC path; only what reads legacy records remains.
statuses.quarantined: A license, terms or provenance problem blocks execution until a maintainer decision.

adoption.note: The qualifier attests the live host against the one canonical macOS profile. The 8 GB Mac and the iPhone remain product floors, not evaluator hosts.

identitySplit.output: Everything that can change a judge's output: model, weights and runtime digests, runtime package versions, the worker or adapter source and command template, label map, decode options and preprocessing, the declared thread count, and the host until the judge's cross-host determinism is measured (AQ-06). It keys caches and calibration records.
identitySplit.envelope: How a run was supervised: the resource supervisor's source, its probe and options. Provenance only; a change never invalidates a cache entry or a calibration.

admission.budgetBasis: The canonical Mac mini M6's 16 GiB. Raised from 10 GiB (the audit section 3.4 estimate) on 2026-09-29 by maintainer decision, after the AQ-07 panels over 1,888-recording cohorts measured it: at most 5.6 GiB for the largest worker (Whisper large-v3; ceilings are peak x 1.2), host free memory at 55-75% between launches with the lead session and tooling running, and memory pressure normal throughout. At 10 GiB a GPU recognizer's ceiling left no room for a CPU judge beside it; 12 GiB admits one (Audiobox's 3.6 GiB ceiling beside a 6.8 GiB recognizer and the orchestrator reservation). The supervisor still ends a worker on its ceiling, and pressure, swap growth or a slow recovery remain host conditions. Provisional until a full panel runs at this budget.
admission.orchestratorReservationBasis: The orchestrator and its in-process Stage 1 DSP (about 0.2 GB plus 0.3 GB, audit section 3.4, est.); budget only, never a worker slot.

gpu.note: One MLX worker at a time: MLX workers share one GPU and its unified-memory working set.

cpu.note: At most two CPU neural workers beside the GPU worker.

dsp.note: Stage 1 DSP: each orchestrator's in-process L0 and Stage 1 take one dsp slot (its memory inside the orchestrator reservation), and a Stage 1 worker pool later.

admission.ceilingRule: A worker's admission ceiling is its judge's calibrated ceiling once AQ-06 qualification promoted it (resources.ceilingBytes, the larger canonical-host peak of two clean runs x 1.2, ceilingStatus calibrated, ceilingSession naming the session of its committed canary record, or of the committed ceiling-recalibration session that re-measured it over a full cohort, with ceilingHistory keeping each replaced ceiling), else its provisional ceiling; a judge with neither is refused. The qualification run admits a judge whose ceilingStatus is provisional at the budget less the orchestrator reservation, and a ceiling recalibration admits every judge there, so neither an estimate nor a canary ceiling cuts a measurement short. The supervisor enforces the same ceiling live on the worker's whole process group (the worker and every command it runs, summed each sample), so the budget is a bound.
admission.generatorExclusion: The host lock and the admission ledger live under the one host-wide analysis lock root (config/build-output-policy.json hostAnalysisLock), whatever the checkout or cache root. A generator and every standalone analyzer hold the host lock exclusively; an orchestrator run holds it shared and every worker it admits inherits that descriptor. No evaluator runs beside a resident generator, no generator starts beside an evaluator, and a run on a busy host refuses to start.

recoveryRule.reason: While the whole-host rule binds, one worker's post-exit drop in host free memory cannot be told apart from another worker's allocation, so admission caps the host at one supervised worker, and each orchestrator's in-process L0 and Stage 1 DSP take a slot of that cap. Making the child-attributed rule binding lifts the cap to the lane limits.

requires: At least two recovery reports (delivery_resource_supervisor.py recovery-report), each saved as a file committed to this repository and cited here by its repository path, file SHA-256 and date; the counts are read from the committed file, never from this registry.

Each report's envelopes ran on the canonical hardware profile (hostProfileIDs is the canonical profile's id, envelopesWithoutHost is 0) and name their sessions (envelopesWithoutSession is 0); no two reports share a session.

Every orchestrated worker judge (lanes gpu and cpu) has at least one serial envelope in each report (serialByJudge), and overlapPossibleEnvelopes is 0: an admitted envelope is serial only when the one-worker cap also held back every orchestrator's in-process L0 and Stage 1.
Each report has serialEnvelopes of at least 1 and serialCandidateWouldQualifyBindingFailure of 0: when nothing else ran, the candidate never blamed a post-exit drop on another allocator.
Each report has unattributed 0: the kernel pressure level and physical memory read on every envelope.

SOMOS (CC BY-NC-SA) and Blizzard samples in training; 3.6 GB; out of domain.
Trained on RAVDESS, TESS and SAVEE (non-commercial or research use).
audeering dimensional, emotion2vec+, 3loi Odyssey and tiantiaf MSP-Podcast models: CC BY-NC-SA or MSP-Podcast academic data; emotion2vec+ pseudo-labels undisclosed.
TorchAudio-SQUIM Subjective, SpeechJudge-GRM, Qwen2.5-Omni-3B and Audio Flamingo 3: CC BY-NC, the Qwen Research License or NVIDIA non-commercial terms.
MMS-1B-all, MMS-LID, MMS-FA, the ctc-forced-aligner default (an MMS-300m aligner) and the torchaudio VoxPopuli aligners: CC BY-NC 4.0.

The legacy non-English Moonshine models (tiny and base in Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Ukrainian and Vietnamese, and Spanish) are under the non-commercial Moonshine Community License; the English moonshine-tiny and moonshine-base are MIT and not excluded.
mHuBERT-147 (TTSDS2 multilingual) is CC BY-NC-SA; VERSA wraps non-commercial models without per-metric licenses and installs unpinned backends.
Weights CC BY 4.0 but trained on the NISQA corpus and other research data; reported to be gameable.
BVCC and Blizzard training data (Blizzard samples cannot be redistributed); a research column at most.
Trained on the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 pitch benchmark; pYIN replaces it.
Trained on the NISQA corpus (non-commercial research) and VoiceMOS labels; DNSMOS replaces it.
The seed-tts-eval WavLM-large speaker-verification checkpoint: GigaSpeech pretraining, only for non-commercial research. ResNet293 replaces it as the second speaker family.
Kotoba-Whisper and distil-whisper are the Whisper family, so not an independent family, and not better on read speech.
Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B does not fit 16 GB; an omni model as a per-take judge samples (determinism class D2).
Unmaintained since 2024-04; no license metadata.
Gated click-through terms; no Russian (watch-list).
NGC terms, not a clear permissive license; needs NeMo.
AASIST and deepfake detectors: every output is synthetic, so the score measures detector domain, not defects.
Optimized for English speaker similarity.
Paper withdrawn (arXiv 2509.19852).
zhconv (GPL-2.0+), pykakasi (GPL-3.0), soynlp (GPL-3.0, pulled in by qwen-asr); nemo-text-processing and WeTextProcessing need pynini wheels that are Linux-only.
JSUT and JVS audio are non-commercial; Japanese corpora come from FLEURS, Common Voice, Kokoro, CSS10 and JVNV instead.

DistilHuBERT transcribes nothing and its ridge, elastic-net and PLS heads were never calibrated: no QC measurand (audit section 4.9; retired by AQ-05 as compact.distilhubert@1 and delivery.fitted-heads@2).

useRestrictions.reason: Qwen2-Audio shares the generator's lab (decision 3a) and samples its answers (determinism class D2), so a per-take verdict is neither independent nor repeatable (audit section 4.9).
useRestrictions.forbiddenUse: A per-take judge, a vote or a verdict.
useRestrictions.permittedUse: Research only: pairwise A/B per cell in both orders, scored by answer log-probabilities (audit section 4.7); a matching judge records this restriction as its useRestriction, never votes and is never warn or gating.
